FBE_RELIC_BROKEN_MODEM.title: Broken Modem
FBE_RELIC_BROKEN_MODEM.description:
At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
At the start of combat, afflict your hand with [gold]No Signal[/gold]. Cards drawn this turn are also afflicted. [gold]No Signal[/gold] is removed at the end of the turn.
FBE_RELIC_REMOVED_ROAD_SIGN.description:
At the start of the next [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
(Equivalent to 2 turns of [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].)
FBE_RELIC_REMOVED_ROAD_SIGN.flavor: Proof that you have lost your Kimi spirit.
FBE_RELIC_REMOVED_ROAD_SIGN.title: Uprooted Road Sign
FBE_RELIC_INSIGHT.title: Soul Insight
FBE_RELIC_INSIGHT.description: Upon pickup, view [blue]{RewardCount}[/blue] cards from [gold]other characters[/gold]. Add any number of them to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
FBE_RELIC_INSIGHT.flavor: This power does not belong to you.
FBE_RELIC_INSIGHT.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose any number of cards to add to your Deck
FBE_RELIC_REDEMPTION.title: Redemption
FBE_RELIC_REDEMPTION.description: At the end of Boss combat, heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
FBE_RELIC_TOP_HAT.title: Top Hat
FBE_RELIC_TOP_HAT.description:
Card rewards contain an additional [gold]Bomb[/gold].
[gold]Bomb[/gold] can be played for free.
FBE_RELIC_TOP_HAT.flavor: You feel the urge to blow things up.
FBE_RELIC_DIPLOPIA.title: Diplopia
FBE_RELIC_DIPLOPIA.description: Upon pickup, obtain an additional copy of every card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
FBE_RELIC_PHD.title: PhD
FBE_RELIC_PHD.description: Whenever you use a Potion during combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
FBE_RELIC_DARK_BUM.title: Dark Bum
FBE_RELIC_DARK_BUM.description: Each turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the first card you play, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card, and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
FBE_RELIC_DICE_BAG.title: Dice Bag
FBE_RELIC_DICE_BAG.description: Upon pickup, add [gold]The D20[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
FBE_RELIC_ANARCHIST_COOKBOOK.title: Anarchist Cookbook
FBE_RELIC_ANARCHIST_COOKBOOK.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Mayhem[/gold] and add a [gold]Mayhem[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FBE_RELIC_ANARCHIST_COOKBOOK.flavor: As the saying goes: never let them know your next move.
FBE_RELIC_STARTER_DECK.title: Starter Deck
FBE_RELIC_STARTER_DECK.description: At the end of combat, choose 1 of 2 card bundles to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
FBE_REWARD_STARTER_DECK_BUNDLE.descripti: Choose a card bundle to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
FBE_RELIC_PACKAGING_BOX.title: Packaging Box
FBE_RELIC_PACKAGING_BOX.description: Upon pickup, add a [gold]Packaging Box+[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
FBE_RELIC_PACKAGING_BOX.flavor: Pack it up, then unpack it.
FBE_RELIC_CLICKER.title: Clicker
FBE_RELIC_CLICKER.description: At the start of combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random [gold]Form[/gold] cards to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. They gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold] and cost {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} less.
FBE_RELIC_EDENS_BLESSING.title: Eden's Blessing
FBE_RELIC_EDENS_BLESSING.description: Upon pickup, add a random [gold]Colorless[/gold] card to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
FBE_RELIC_EDENS_BLESSING.flavor: The garden was never truly closed.
